title: SSC CGL Exam Complete Master Guide: Posts, Syllabus, Cut-Offs & Free Preparation Roadmap
summary: The definitive aspirant handbook for Staff Selection Commission Combined Graduate Level (SSC CGL). Detailed breakdown of Tier-1 & Tier-2 schemes, post-wise pay matrices (Level 4 to 8), physical standards, 3-year cutoffs, and 100% free study resources.
author: Sarkari Aavedan Editorial Team
content:
## Introduction & Exam Overview The Staff Selection Commission Combined Graduate Level (**SSC CGL**) examination is one of India's most coveted competitive examinations, recruiting over 15,000+ graduate officers annually across prestigious Central Government Ministries, Departments, and Constitutional Bodies. From **Assistant Section Officer (ASO)** in the Ministry of External Affairs and Central Vigilance Commission to field enforcement positions like **Inspector of Income Tax**, **Central Excise (CGST)**, and **Sub-Inspector in the CBI**, SSC CGL offers unrivaled career security, social prestige, and 7th Central Pay Commission compensation. > [!IMPORTANT] > SSC CGL recruitment is purely based on merit in Computer Based Examinations (CBT). There is **no interview stage** for any Group B or Group C non-gazetted post, ensuring complete transparency and objective selection. ## SSC CGL Posts Hierarchy & Pay Scales (7th CPC) | Post Name & Department | Classification | 7th CPC Pay Level | Pay Band & Entry Basic Pay | Approx In-Hand Salary (X-City) | |---|---|---|---|---| | **Assistant Audit Officer (AAO) / Accounts Officer (CAG)** | Group 'B' Gazetted (Non-Ministerial) | **Level-8** | ₹47,600 – ₹1,51,100 | ₹82,000 – ₹89,000 / month | | **ASO in MEA (Ministry of External Affairs)** | Group 'B' Non-Gazetted | **Level-7** | ₹44,900 – ₹1,42,400 | ₹76,000 – ₹83,000 + Foreign Allowances | | **ASO in CSS (Central Secretariat Service)** | Group 'B' Non-Gazetted | **Level-7** | ₹44,900 – ₹1,42,400 | ₹76,000 – ₹82,000 / month | | **Inspector of Income Tax (CBDT)** | Group 'B' Non-Gazetted | **Level-7** | ₹44,900 – ₹1,42,400 | ₹76,000 – ₹82,000 / month | | **Inspector - Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) and online application on the new official SSC portal (ssc.gov.in) with live webcam photo verification. 2. Appear for the Computer Based Tier-1 Preliminary Screening Examination (Qualifying in nature for Tier-2). 3. Qualify Tier-1 and appear for the high-stakes Tier-2 Main Computer Based Examination covering Section-I, Section-II, and the mandatory Computer Knowledge Test. 4. Undertake the Data Entry Speed Test (DEST) on the same day as Tier-2 (Typing 2,000 key depressions in 15 minutes). 5. Undergo Physical Measurement & Endurance Testing (PET/PST) exclusively for Central Excise, Preventive Officer, Examiner, CBI, and CBN roles. 6. Attend Departmental Document Verification (DV) and medical fitness examination following the final Merit List declaration. ## Tier-1 Examination Pattern & Subject Weightage Tier-1 is a 60-minute computer-based preliminary screening test comprising 100 objective questions for 200 marks. Each wrong answer incurs a penalty of 0.50 marks. | Subject / Domain | Questions | Marks | Mark Weightage Graph | Sectional Focus Areas | |---|---|---|---|---| | **General Intelligence & Reasoning** | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | [BAR:25%:Reasoning] | Syllogisms, Coding-Decoding, Non-Verbal, Analogies, Blood Relations | | **General Awareness (Current & Static GK)** | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | [BAR:25%:General Awareness] | Modern History, Indian Polity & Constitution, Geography, Current Affairs, Science | | **Quantitative Aptitude (Mathematics)** | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | [BAR:25%:Quantitative Aptitude] | Arithmetic (Ratio, Percentages, Work, SI/CI) & Advanced Math (Algebra, Geometry, Trig) | | **English Comprehension** | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | [BAR:25%:English Comprehension] | Reading Comprehension, Vocab, Error Spotting, Cloze Test, Idioms & Phrases | | **Grand Total** | **100 Qs** | **200 Marks** | **[BAR:100%:Total Test]** | **Composite Time: 60 Minutes (80 mins for scribes)** | > [!TIP] > **Tier-1 Score Strategy**: Since Tier-1 is now strictly qualifying, aim for a balanced 140+ score. Focus 70% of your initial practice on **Reasoning** and **English**, where achieving 45+/50 is realistic with consistent past-paper drills. ## Tier-2 Examination Pattern (Merit Deciding Stage) Tier-2 determines your final All India Rank (AIR) and department allocation. It is conducted in two sessions on the same day. | Paper / Session | Module & Subject | Questions & Marks | Timing | Merit Weightage & Qualifying Criteria | |---|---|---|---|---| | **Session 1: Section I** | Module 1: Mathematical Abilities

Mandatory for ALL posts. | | **Paper II (Optional)** | Statistics (Only for Junior Statistical Officer - JSO) | 100 Qs × 2 = 200 Marks | 2 Hours | Applicable only for candidates who opted and qualified for JSO. | ## Recent Cut-Off Trends (Tier-1 General Candidate Benchmark) | Recruitment Year | Unreserved (UR) | Other Backward Classes (OBC) | Economically Weaker Section (EWS) | Scheduled Caste (SC) | Scheduled Tribe (ST) | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | **SSC CGL 2024 - 2025** | 153.25 | 148.60 | 144.15 | 126.85 | 118.20 | | **SSC CGL 2023** | 150.04 | 145.93 | 143.44 | 126.69 | 118.16 | | **SSC CGL 2022 (Mega Vacancy)** | 114.27 | 114.27 | 102.35 | 89.08 | 77.56 | ## Mandatory Physical Standards (For Excise, Preventive & CBI Posts) | Gender | Minimum Height Requirement | Chest Measurement | Physical Endurance Test (PET) | |---|---|---|---| | **Male Candidates** | 157.5 cm (Relaxable by 5 cm for Garhwalis, Assamese, Gorkhas & ST) | 81 cm (Fully expanded with min 5 cm expansion) | Walking: 1,600 meters in 15 minutes

Solve 50 questions daily per subject. | | **Days 31 – 60** | Shift to Sectional Practice. Complete 1,000+ Previous Year Questions (PYQs) from 2020 to 2024. Practice 15 minutes of daily computer typing for DEST. | Increase math speed using calculation shortcuts. Aim for 45/50 in Reasoning. | | **Days 61 – 75** | Take 1 Full-Length Tier-1 Mock every alternate day under strict 60-minute exam conditions. Spend 2 hours analyzing errors. | Consistently score 140+ in full-length mock tests. | | **Days 76 – 90** | Revise static GK formulas, current affairs of the last 8 months, vocab flashcards, and take 1 mock test daily.
